answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 13 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 260 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. What carries the timber here is verification, the reef of cost is what stops the farm, and the jetty of the record keeps every claim checkable.
